anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly on this case: it validates the recovered record (course, both caps/usage, matching head/body/scope) instead of rejecting it as malformed, treats numeric 2 on the obstacle menu as a persisted course switch to assess with counters untouched, re-enters step 5 on the unchanged head with CONFLICTING triggering no sync and no repair under assess, posts exactly one --comment review on the own PR after compare-and-swap, and handles exact `show evidence` as a read-only print that settles nothing and re-renders the same assess terminal with stop recommended last and approve omitted. Before failed all three because it had no notion of courses or sync caps, so it declared the record malformed, refused the pick, posted nothing, and fell back to an update-branch wait menu. No fact regressed; one thing worth keeping explicit in the After wording is that the assess write happens after the course persist (so the ordering 'persist before another mutation' is visible), and that the show-evidence dump restates caps/usage unchanged so the no-authority property is checkable from the text.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Nothing moved: After persists `course: assess` before any external write (f1), explicitly applies no edit and runs no fetch/rebase/merge/push after the switch (f2), and handles `show evidence` as a non-authorizing display with rounds 1/6, syncs 1/6 preserved and a single `--comment` review on the own PR (f3). Two things worth tightening without touching the facts: After reorders the Entry sequence by posting the review and rendering the assess terminal before handling `show evidence` (Entry has the human type it right after `2`), so state explicitly that `show evidence` is recognized whenever it arrives and simply re-renders the current checkpoint; and the assess terminal's `1. deliver` row should say it starts no work until a numeric pick, so a reader does not read the re-rendered menu as pending repair authority after the comment post.
